description: Reports what's worth knowing today about the models saved to the user's Hemrock account: for each of the ten most recently edited cap tables, exit waterfalls and fund models, notes where a number has crossed a line worth a look (a thin option pool, unconverted SAFEs, preferences taking most of an exit, a heavy fee load, a fund life past 12 years, a model untouched for 90 days), each with the number in it. Also lists live workshops in the next few weeks and the services that fit what's saved. Call it when the user asks how their models look, or on a scheduled check-in or morning brief. Lead with flagged notes; if nothing is flagged, say little or nothing. Free and read-only. Needs a signed-in connection.
name: check_in
title: Check in on saved models
